evals.prompt: PUT /api/settings で保持日数を延ばしても、もう期限切れで Cron の削除待ちになっているセクションは復活しない、というのをテストで保証したい。書いて。
evals.expected_output: Route test in worker/board/routes.test.ts using the per-test D1 fixture, mounting settingsRoutes, asserting response and rows.
assertions: The test is added to worker/board/routes.test.ts (or a sibling worker test) and uses the db fixture from worker/d1-test.ts (no getPlatformProxy in beforeAll, no beforeEach cleanup added)
D1 is not mocked; settingsRoutes is called through app.request (or worker.fetch) with the real local D1
Inserts an already-expired row and a still-visible row, then PUTs a longer memoTtlDays
Asserts the expired row's expires_at is unchanged (still in the past) and the visible row's expires_at moved to createdAt + new days, by reading rows back
Asserts the expired section is not returned by GET /api/board after the change
